Date of Loss: April 2, 2026  
Policy & Edition: HO-0304, Edition 03-24  
Loss Description: The shower pan has been leaking slowly for months, resulting in soft joists beneath the bathroom; estimated loss $50,600.  
Coverage Determination: deny

Deductible: $1,000 All Perils
